rows.method_detail: phonons in a coherent-state mean field (fb-BE); linear in 1/L, L = 150 to 350
rows.bound_type_reason: series expansion, spin-wave theory or another fixed approximation; error of unknown sign (RULES.md 14.4)
rows.reference: Islam, Bierman & Liu, Bootstrap embedding for interacting electrons in phonon coherent-state mean field, J. Chem. Phys. 164, 124111 (2026), doi:10.1063/5.0320786, arXiv:2603.11463

verified.method: arXiv:2603.11463: journal version: Table I of the article page on pubs.aip.org (2026-11-25), all eleven values equal to the arXiv text's; Hamiltonian and fit read in the arXiv text (sources/2603.11463.txt); first reading and a blind second reading (2026-11-24/25)
verified.note: Table I, U = 6 (arXiv line 270) | Eqs. (2)-(4): Hubbard model plus ω0 sum b+b + g sum n_i (b+_i + b_i), no zero-point term; t = 1, g = 0.1, ω0 = 0.25 (Table I caption), half-filled chain; energy per site including ω0 sum |α_i|² (line 218), E∞ from a linear fit in 1/L over L = 150, 200, 300, 350. The phonons are a product of coherent states (mean field) and the text calls the embedding non-variational (line 349). No conversion.
